title: Spiders Eat 400 to 800 Million Tons of Insects a Year

scenes.text: Spiders eat four hundred million tons of prey every year.
That's roughly what all humans eat in meat and fish, and it could be double.
More than ninety percent of it is insects.
There are over forty-five thousand spider species, and in some places, a thousand live in one square meter.
All spiders together weigh about twenty-five million tons.
Spiders eat as much as we do.
